name: Doro Wat
description: Ethiopia's national dish — chicken slow-simmered in a deep red berbere sauce, served with injera and a boiled egg.

name: Kitfo
description: Finely minced premium beef tossed in mitmita chili and kibbe, served with gomen and a side of ayib cheese.

name: Beyaynetu (Fasting Platter)
description: A colorful vegetarian mosaic of misir, shiro, atakilt wat, gomen and salaata, all on one tray of injera.

name: Shekla Tibs
description: Cubes of tender beef pan-seared with onion, jalapeño and rosemary, served sizzling in a clay shekla dish.

name: Shiro Wat
description: Silky spiced chickpea stew — comforting, vegan-friendly and one of the most loved everyday Ethiopian dishes.

name: Kitfo Special Tibs Firfir
description: Injera torn and tossed through a peppery tibs sauce with bits of sautéed beef — bold, saucy and addictive.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: Thin-crust classic topped with San Marzano-style tomato sauce, mozzarella and fresh basil.

name: Addis Special Pizza
description: Our house favorite — berbere-spiced beef, mitmita chicken, onions and jalapeños on a cheesy thin crust.

name: Veggie Supreme
description: Loaded with mushrooms, green peppers, olives, onions and sweetcorn over our signature tomato base.

name: Four Cheese Pizza
description: Mozzarella, cheddar, feta and ayib melted together for the cheesiest slice in Addis.

name: Classic Beef Burger
description: Flame-grilled 150g beef patty, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, pickles and house burger sauce.

name: Double Trouble Burger
description: Two flame-grilled patties, double cheddar, crispy onions and smoky BBQ sauce. Come hungry.

name: Mitmita Chicken Burger
description: Grilled chicken thigh glazed in mitmita honey sauce with slaw and jalapeño mayo.

name: Veggie Bean Burger
description: Crispy shiro-and-bean patty with avocado, salad and tahini yogurt sauce.

name: Buna — Ethiopian Coffee
description: Freshly roasted and brewed the traditional way — served with a side of incense and popcorn.

name: Ambo Sparkling Water
description: Ethiopia's iconic naturally sparkling mineral water, served ice cold.

name: Fresh Mango Juice
description: Blended from tree-ripe Ethiopian mangoes — thick, cold and 100% fruit.

name: Spris — Layered Juice
description: Striking layers of avocado, mango, papaya and guava in one tall glass. As beautiful as it is refreshing.
